name: Cuantización de Color de Video
algorithm: Color Quantization — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes color quantization patterns in video for forensic detection:

1. **Color Precision Análisis**: The effective number of distinct colors per frame is measured and compared to the expected color depth of the video format. Natural video captured at 8-bit depth shows characteristic color quantization patterns including smooth gradient banding. AI-generated content may exhibit different quantization characteristics — either smoother (floating-point internal representation posterized to 8-bit) or with artificial color clustering.

2. **Quantization Step Detección**: Color channel histograms are analyzed for quantization artifacts — periodic gaps or peaks in the histogram indicate specific quantization step sizes. Double-quantization from re-encoding produces characteristic paired histogram features detectable via spectral analysis of the histogram signal.

3. **Espacial Quantization Consistencia**: Quantization patterns should be spatially uniform (same encoding pipeline). The method compares quantization characteristics between face regions and background. Deepfake composites may show different quantization in the generated face (from the generator's output pipeline) versus the original background footage.

4. **Gradiente Banding Análisis**: Smooth gradients in the image reveal quantization characteristics. Natural camera capture plus compression produces specific banding patterns. AI-generated gradients may show finer or coarser banding inconsistent with the declared bit depth and codec, revealing post-processing or generation artifacts.

5. **Temporal Quantization Seguimiento**: Color quantization characteristics are tracked across frames. Authentic video maintains consistent quantization throughout. AI-generated content may show varying quantization quality across frames, particularly in face regions where the generator's output precision may fluctuate.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante color quantization analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
